verdict.rationale: Kick documents MCP, CLI and a gated Platform API that uses an organization Bearer token, but nothing shows scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The MCP connection docs say the opposite: custom tools get "full access to read and update your Kick data" and Cursor gets "full control." Role-based access control exists for workspace members, but that is an adjacent user-permission feature, not scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
